frontier: Implement and exhaustively verify the physical D4 observation support and closed-form conditioned likelihood.

resolved: The paper's practical D4 [2] decoder is PyMatching MWPM with herald-conditioned negative weights, not an ILP decoder.
The paper's optimal result is a posterior logical-sector sum evaluated through a statistical-mechanics Monte Carlo mapping.
A MILP decoder is registered only as a bounded project extension and must be validated against exhaustive enumeration.
Publication-scale sampling is deferred until a bounded pilot passes all model and solver gates.
The direct Eq. A12 form P(s|E)=2^(C-N_internal) is used until the geometry-specific length/Y/flux identity is independently verified.
Periodic winding loops are detected but receive no guessed even-parity constraint because Appendix A makes it logical-sector dependent.
The schema-v3 sampler preserves winding physical errors and marks them logical_failure without inventing an absolute-sector charge record.
Schema v2 distinguishes even, odd, and unconstrained winding-colour parity; all nine abstract two-colour policy branches are verified without claiming a complete physical D4 sector map.
Logical Z=+1/-1/indefinite maps to even/odd/unconstrained winding parity; the Iqbal all-plus state is a candidate, not an inferred Jing threshold-simulation sector.

Physical and correction Pauli-X operators compose by GF(2) symmetric difference, but Appendix A's first logical decision uses homology of their Boolean union because both rounds contribute to the post-flux stabilizer history.
Post-flux same-colour star constraints are accumulated transitively by DSU; the A13-A14 fixture imposes even parity on stars 1 and 3.
The seven Appendix-A post-flux local rules generate 21 distinct rotational cases; unlisted local configurations fail closed.
The primary initial state is an anyon-free ground state; its absolute topological-sector label is ignored and any nontrivial winding action is a logical error.
The source forcing rule is invariant K=3E; the primitive honeycomb size is not the paper's L, whose coloured unit cell has 6L^2 affected vertices and 9L^2 edges.

The 42 selected colour/row/rotation fixtures do not cover arbitrary mirrored MWPM outputs; the printed table is diagnostic only, while production uses one blue and one green parity component per connected physical/correction union component.

For a homologically trivial flux union, a deterministic relation-forest Pauli-Z representative and unit-weight same-colour MWPM implement the source's second charge-recovery stage on bounded fixtures.

Both public practical modes now consume the same physical error and first observation through a versioned end-to-end record; the 192-record audit verifies continuity and truth invariants without interpreting its logical counts as an LER.

On the matched paper-L=2 cohort, both first-stage PyMatching objectives are exhaustive-global minima, but tied minimum-weight corrections can have different Boolean-union logical outcomes; minimum weight is therefore not a unique logical or Bayes oracle.
